name: Barato Reiko
source:
Third year student, Extreme Golf Club member

She is a third year at Toaru Girls Academy. Her personality is elegant and very princess-like, without being too arrogant. She is skilled at golf and is able to play an entire game with her favorite 5 iron. Her family owns a large black tea company, which complements the thrilling performances she displays with her tee shot.
